what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Tanzania in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2777 Tanzanian asylum seekers, and Canada hosted 29.2% of them.
After Canada, the largest hosts are South Korea, Israel and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Tanzania: with the Islamic State group in 2020.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Tanzania.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 801 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 5236, at the end of 2005.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2003 to 2005, 2007 to 2008 and 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
